# Descriptions
@@ 1
For the duration, the caster gains a +5 bonus to all skills in the Influence
skill category (and any other skill that deals with interaction with people).
@@ 2
One humanoid target of the opposite sex believes the caster is a good friend.
The target’s RR can be modified by racial prejudices.
@@ 3
Causes a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and
subtracting 10 from all attacks.
@@ 4
As Charm Opposite I, but one sentient plant is affected.
@@ 5
Caster emotionally and/or sensually manipulates one humanoid target (emotional
attachment may result). Caster receives a bonus to his Seduction maneuvers
against this target equal to the amount the target failed his RR. For example,
if a target fails a RR by 15, the caster gets +15 to all Seduction maneuvers
for the duration of the spell.
@@ 6
As Charm Opposite I, except up to two targets may be affected.
@@ 7
As Charm Opposite I, except one creature with animal intelligence is affected.
@@ 8
Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien (e.g.
suicide, blinding himself, etc.). This spell expires when the target completes
the action.
@@ 9
As Charm Opposite I, except a member of the same sex is affected.
@@ 10
As Charm Opposite I, except up to 3 targets may be affected.
@@ 11
As Empathy I, except the bonus is +10.
@@ 12
As Charm Opposite I, except affects any sentient being.
@@ 13
As Self Aura, except 20 is subtracted from all attacks.
@@ 14
As Charm Opposite I, except up to 5 targets may be affected.
@@ 15
Target is given one task that must be within its abilities. Failure or refusal
to perform the task results in the target taking 3 ‘E’ electricity criticals.
@@ 16
As Charm Plant I, except up to 3 plants may be affected.
@@ 17
As Suggestion I, except up to 3 targets may be given the same suggestion.
@@ 18
As Charm Animal I, except up to 3 animals may be affected.
@@ 19
As Charm Same I, except up to 3 targets may be affected.
@@ 20
As Charm Opposite I, except up to 10 targets may be affected.
@@ 25
As Geas, except failure results in death.
@@ 30
As Self Aura, except caster seems like a demi-god and the penalty to all
attacks is -30.
@@ 50
Caster can use one lower level spell from this list every round.
